job.question: Under Missouri LAGERS' private markets consultant RFP, how many public fund clients of what minimum size must a respondent provide non-discretionary private market investment consulting to?
job.expected_facts: At least three public fund clients with assets of at least $10 billion (as of March 31, 2024).
job.acceptance: At least three public-fund clients with at least $10bn each. March31,2024 is a useful qualifier, not a separately asked fact.

reviews.reason: This is Oklahoma OPERS’ 2022 general investment consulting RFP, not Missouri LAGERS’ private markets consultant RFP. Its five-client qualification and three-reference request do not establish the specified non-discretionary private-markets requirement or $10 billion minimum.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-22-200 INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES
OPERS is seeking the services of a general investment consultant
The proposed investment consultant must have acted as full-service consultant to at least five public pension plans, each with at least $1 billion in assets, as of June 30, 2021.
Provide three references for the largest public fund clients who employ your firm.
